# Checks

Each check of tools/ci registers itself from one file,
`tools/ci/check_<check>.go`, and lives in one package below
`tools/ci/internal/`
([12 12.2](../spec/12-engineering.md#122-development-commands-and-capability-map)).
fast and all run the checks they hold in the order below, except that
every check that judges the tree runs before the first one that runs
code of the change, and the checks of the commit judge the commit read
before any step.
The requirement id is the one of the row of the check in the step table of
[10 10.2](../spec/10-testing-style.md#102-ci); `-` marks a row that holds none.

| Check | Guards | Usage | Runs in | Order | Runs code of the change | Requirement | Package |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | every Go file is formatted as gofmt formats it | `gofmt -l .` | fast, all | 10 | no | REQ-0820 | [tools/ci/internal/format](../../tools/ci/internal/format/) |
| `vet` | go vet finds nothing in the module | `go vet ./...` | fast, all | 20 | no | REQ-0820 | [tools/ci/internal/vet](../../tools/ci/internal/vet/) |
| `generated` | the generated files are what go generate writes, each tracked as a regular file | `go run ./tools/ci generated` | fast, all | 30 | no | REQ-0822 | [tools/ci/internal/drift](../../tools/ci/internal/drift/) |
| `lint` | the linters of .golangci.yml find nothing, for each lint target | `golangci-lint run --config .golangci.yml, once per lint target` | fast, all | 40 | no | REQ-0823 | [tools/ci/internal/lint](../../tools/ci/internal/lint/) |
| `vulnerabilities` | no known vulnerability of the Go vulnerability database reaches the module | `govulncheck ./...` | all | 50 | no | REQ-0831 | [tools/ci/internal/vulnerabilities](../../tools/ci/internal/vulnerabilities/) |
| `license` | every file carries its license and copyright, as REUSE 3.3 asks | `reuse lint, from the image pinned by digest` | all | 60 | no | REQ-0847 | [tools/ci/internal/license](../../tools/ci/internal/license/) |
| `unit` | the tests of internal/ and tools/ pass | `go test -count=1 ./internal/... ./tools/...` | fast, all | 70 | yes | REQ-0824 | [tools/ci/internal/unit](../../tools/ci/internal/unit/) |
| `race` | every test of the module passes with the race detector, which writes the cover profile | `go test -race -count=1 -coverprofile=<temporary directory>/cover.out ./...` | all | 80 | yes | REQ-0833 | [tools/ci/internal/race](../../tools/ci/internal/race/) |
| `hygiene` | the tracked paths and their content keep the hygiene rules and hold no forbidden name | `go run ./tools/ci hygiene [--file <path>]; go run ./tools/ci hygiene add` | fast, all | 100 | no | REQ-1240 | [tools/ci/internal/hygiene](../../tools/ci/internal/hygiene/) |
| `workflows` | every workflow keeps the closed grammar of 10 10.2 | `go run ./tools/ci workflows` | fast, all | 110 | no | REQ-1241 | [tools/ci/internal/workflows](../../tools/ci/internal/workflows/) |
| `reqs` | the requirement ids of the specification and of the task files keep the rules of 12 12.11 | `go run ./tools/ci reqs [allocate]` | fast, all | 120 | no | REQ-0829 | [tools/ci/internal/reqs](../../tools/ci/internal/reqs/) |
| `plan` | the task files of docs/plan/tasks keep the fields, the ids, the edges and the overlap rule of docs/plan.md | `go run ./tools/ci plan [--critical-path \| --ready]` | fast, all | 125 | no | REQ-0826 | [tools/ci/internal/plan](../../tools/ci/internal/plan/) |
| `pushed range` | a push publishes no forbidden name, and no commit of it adds a never-tracked file | `go run ./tools/ci fast <remote> <url>, as the pre-push hook runs it` | fast, in the pre-push hook only | 130 | no | REQ-0825 | [tools/ci/internal/pushedrange](../../tools/ci/internal/pushedrange/) |
| `coverage` | every measured package meets its coverage threshold of S9 | `go run ./tools/ci coverage <profile>` | all | 140 | no | REQ-0834 | [tools/ci/internal/coverage](../../tools/ci/internal/coverage/) |
